title: E-FRC-0235: the massless branch of the quantum light: the plaquette ladder's rule on a strip of husk squares closed...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0235 in the gauge arena: the massless branch of the quantum light: the plaquette ladder's rule on a strip of husk squares closed around its width has a one-quantum band on the classical E~ light's massless symbol, omega(0) = 0 and slope sqrt(kappa), with no photon at k = 0 (the uniform shift is no state on a closed surface), and the husk's own axis photon solves lambda^2 - 12 lambda + 8u = 0, so its light speed is sqrt(2 kappa / 3).
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
